description: A barefoot young person in a worn wide-brimmed hat and dusty loose shirt crouches on a stony riverbank, looking closely at a small glowing stone in cupped fingers. A handful of ordinary pebbles sits in the other palm, and a single bright crystal lies in the sand below. Behind is a dark, still river and dry scrub under a shadowy hillside. Painterly, warm, low light, no text or border.
